title: LIGHT Hypnotherapy
description: EEG and ECG recordings collected during guided imagery hypnotherapy (LIGHT) sessions, in which a hypnotherapist uses storytelling and deep visualization to promote personal growth and well-being. The approach targets eudaemonic well-being, emphasizing meaning and self-realization, which distinguishes it from traditional hypnotherapy. The dataset includes a baseline resting EEG session and in-lab recordings from selected hypnotherapy sessions.
methods_description: Baseline resting EEG (5 minutes) was recorded in the lab about 2 weeks before the first session (session 0). LIGHT sessions were conducted virtually, except sessions 1, 4, and 8, during which EEG and ECG were recorded. Each session followed a script of guided relaxation/induction, visualization of a place of comfort, a path or stairs, a chair and crown, and a light moving through the body, ending with a count up to an awake state. Hypnotherapy recordings vary in length and contain events marking hypnotherapist phase transitions.
